KANNON K. SHANMUGAM 

TELEPHONE 
FACSIMILE 

(202) 223-7325 
(202) 204-7397 

E-MAIL:  kshanmugam@paulweiss.com  

November 19, 2019 

BY MESSENGER AND ELECTRONIC FILING 

Mr. Scott Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re:  Walker v. United States, No. 19-373 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent petitioner in the above-captioned matter.  I am writing on behalf 
of  both  parties  to  request  extensions  of  time  for  filing  the  merits  briefs  and  joint 
appendix in this case, as follows: 

Brief for the petitioner and joint appendix: 
Brief for the United States: 

January 6, 2020 
February 12, 2020 

Both parties have agreed to the foregoing schedule, which would enable this case to 
be  heard  during  the  Court’s  March  2020  sitting.    Should  you  need  any  additional 
information, please do not hesitate to let me know. 

Yours sincerely, 

Kannon K. Shanmugam 

cc:  Noel J. Francisco, Esq. (by U.S. mail)
